相關單：MKT-530 雙 11 折價券（另一案）、MKT-541 實體門市集點活動（另一案）

需求摘要
會員在 LINE 小程式內依消費金額取得抽獎券，12/31 統一開獎，獎項包含機票、家電與購物金，預估參與人數 30 萬。

進度紀錄
- 10/02 UI 稿確認，橙果開始切版。
- 10/09 會員 API 串接完成，可讀取近 90 天的消費金額。
- 10/15 抽獎演算法與開獎流程和律師確認，開獎時需由公證人到場見證。
- 10/20 前台完成約 80%，進入內部測試，回報 23 個問題，已修 19 個。
- 10/23 法務意見：活動辦法中「消費滿額才能抽」再加上「指定品牌加倍」，可能被認定為以抽獎促銷特定商品，有違反公平交易法相關規範的風險，建議大幅修改或改為非抽獎形式。

Today: 2026-06-04
Larkspur discharge-summary integration - fortnightly working group, Thursday 4 June 2026 (minutes by Coral Jennings). Larkspur is the project these minutes are about: sending discharge summaries from St Brendan's Hospital straight into GP practice systems. Other Northfield Health digital projects were discussed briefly at the end.

Present: Coral Jennings (programme manager), Dr Amit Kulkarni (clinical lead), Sean Whelan (integration engineer), Beatrix Lowe (information governance), Pavel Novak (supplier engineer, by phone).

1. Clinical content
Dr Kulkarni reported that the discharge-summary template is now agreed with both the medical and surgical directorates. The medication-changes section will list stopped, started and changed drugs separately, which the GP reference group asked for. The template is version 1.4 and is frozen for the pilot.

2. Message build and testing
Sean has built the outbound message in the hospital's integration engine and it validates against the national FHIR profile with no errors. Twenty synthetic summaries have been sent to the supplier's test endpoint and rendered correctly in the GP system's test inbox. Pavel said the supplier's side of the interface is ready for live traffic from their end.

3. Information governance
Beatrix explained where things stand on the data-sharing agreement. The hospital trust has signed. The agreement also needs a signature from each of the eleven pilot GP practices, and those signatures cannot be collected until the regional data-protection officer approves the revised privacy notice, which was resubmitted on May 12 after her first round of comments. She has not responded yet, and her office says it is working through a backlog without giving a date. Until the privacy notice is approved, no practice can sign, and without signed agreements we are not allowed to send a single real patient's summary, so live testing and the pilot cannot begin. Sean confirmed there is nothing more to build or test with synthetic data. The group agreed there is no lawful shortcut here.

4. Training
Coral has drafted a one-page guide for GP practice staff on where the summaries will appear and how to reconcile medications. It will be finalised once the practices are able to join.

5. Other Northfield Health digital projects (for information)
- The outpatient video-clinic rollout was cancelled by the trust board last week in favour of the regional platform; Larkspur never shared any components with it.
- E-prescribing in the emergency department is three weeks behind because of a ward-network upgrade, with a new go-live of July 20.
- The bed-management dashboard went live on May 28 and is being used in daily huddles.

6. Risks
Dr Kulkarni noted that clinicians are keen and asking when summaries will start reaching GPs; Coral will send a short holding message to the directorates. Pavel noted that the supplier's test endpoint certificates expire in October, which is far enough away not to matter for now.

Actions
- Beatrix: chase the regional DPO's office weekly and report any reply to the group.
- Coral: send the holding message to clinical directorates.
- Sean: keep the synthetic test pack ready; no further build work planned.
- Dr Kulkarni: brief the GP reference group at their June meeting.

Next meeting: Thursday 18 June 2026, 14:00, Seminar Room 2.
